definitions.gloss: academic subject; course of study; discipline
definitions.explanation: A field or area of study in an educational context.
An administrative division of a university or college specializing in a particular field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{学科|がっか}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学科|がっか}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：02816_goukaku⟧。
examples.english: I passed the written test for my driver's license.
examples.notes: [Note: {学科|がっか}{試験|しけん} = written/theory test (vs. {実技|じつぎ}{試験|しけん} = practical test)]

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧{学科|がっか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}んでいる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I'm studying in the university's information science department.

notes:
DRIVER'S LICENSE:
・{学科|がっか}{試験|しけん} (written/theory test)
・{学科|がっか}{教習|きょうしゅう} (classroom instruction)

CONTRAST:
・{学科|がっか} (academic/theory) vs {実技|じつぎ} (practical skills)
・{学科|がっか}{試験|しけん} (written test) vs {実技|じつぎ}{試験|しけん} (practical test)

EDUCATION:
・{主要|しゅよう}{学科|がっか} (main/major subjects)
・{選択|せんたく}{学科|がっか} (elective subjects)
・{専門|せんもん}{学科|がっか} (specialized department)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{科目|かもく} (subject, course - more general)
・{教科|きょうか} (school subject - elementary/secondary)
・{専攻|せんこう} (major - university)
